_comment: Constraint budget, checked by scripts/check-budget.mjs (`just budget`).
`constraints` is the exact snarkjs r1cs count and must be updated in the
same commit as any circuit change, so the change lands as a reviewable diff.
`domain` is the Groth16 FFT domain the circuit must fit; exceeding it means
a larger ptau and roughly double the proving time.
snarkjs sizes that domain from nConstraints + nPubInputs + nOutputs and
requires the sum to be at most domain - 1, so with one public input and two
public outputs (y, digest) the ceiling on `constraints` is domain - 4
(131068 at 2^17, 65532 at 2^16). check-budget.mjs computes that bound rather
than comparing against `domain` directly.
The two are ceremony-paired but not domain-paired: a spend's output leaves
are inserted by the batch circuit, so they share DEPTH = 11, while each sits
in its own domain. 4x6 is in 2^17 with ~61.8k of headroom; it is ~3.8k over
the 2^16 ceiling.
tree_update_batch is in 2^16 with ~24.0k. It inserts its leaves in one
batched build (lib/batch_append.circom): about 22 Poseidon(5) for the tree
at MAX_L = 8, growing with depth rather than leaf count, plus the
coefficient digest, 9 Poseidon(5) over its 36 words (7,515).
Measured: a depth level adds 2,534 and a leaf slot about 1,800 (one
Poseidon(3), two 64-bit range checks, its share of the append window, and
one digest block per slot). So 2^16 holds through DEPTH = 20 at MAX_L = 8,
and at DEPTH = 11 through MAX_L = 16 (56,026); MAX_L = 32 is 85,891 and
needs 2^17.
